actual_behavior: The first protected Pages job failed in actions/configure-pages because the repository had no Pages site. After enablement and recovery, the deployed site still carried pre-publication 'unreleased beta' wording. PyPI and the immutable GitHub Release had already succeeded.
expected_behavior: Release preparation verifies that GitHub Pages exists with build_type=workflow before any immutable registry publication begins.

failure.error: Get Pages site failed: Not Found; verify the repository has Pages enabled

impact: The release temporarily entered a partial state, then a public-truth mismatch: package and GitHub Release public while documentation was first unavailable and then labeled unreleased.

review.finding: P1: grant the prepare job Pages read permission before querying the Pages API
review.repair: The prepare job now grants only actions:read, contents:read, and pages:read.

findings: P1: pin docs-only checkout to a trusted ref
P2: avoid a hard-coded release version on the docs landing page
repairs: The one-time docs-only job accepts only the exact reviewed v0.9.2 docs source digest; later content needs a new reviewed change and human deployment approval.
The landing page refers to the versioned banner and stable registry/release-history URLs.

final_review_repairs: Bound the one-time recovery to an exact docs source digest instead of a reusable later commit.
Removed the tag-to-main history restriction; any new correction now needs a new approval path.
Limited the digest to MkDocs-published sources so excluded evidence updates cannot block the exact site correction.

repair.future_release_preflight: The prepare job now requires the repository Pages API to report build_type=workflow before preparing or reusing a candidate.
repair.post_release_truth_repair: A packet-approved docs-only path redeploys corrected 0.9.2 wording without repeating immutable PyPI or GitHub Release writes.
